title: syringa emodi f. aureovariegata
intro: Syringa emodi f. aureovariegata, commonly known as the golden variegated Himalayan lilac, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Oleaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Syringa emodi f. aureovariegata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
